questions.stem: What type of current does an AC generator (alternator) produce?

options.text: Direct current that flows in one direction only
Alternating current that reverses direction periodically
Pulsed current that stops and starts
Static charge that builds up on the coil

questions.explanation: An AC generator (alternator) produces alternating current, which continuously reverses direction. As the coil rotates in the magnetic field, the direction of the induced current changes every half rotation, creating a sinusoidal output.
